quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Market position (company citing CFM data): independent third-party controller vendors shipped about 51% of global SSD controllers in 2025, and Maxio's share of independent third-party SSD controller shipments was about 30%, up 5 percentage points from 2024, ranking second globally. Most global SSD brands except some NAND makers' own brands use its controllers in consumer retail SSDs, its consumer controllers are in many PC OEM brands, and its SATA controllers are in large-scale commercial use at many server makers.
quarterly_data.figure: about 51% independent third-party share of 2025 SSD controller shipments; Maxio about 30% of independent shipments (+5 percentage points)

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New products: its consumer PCIe 5.0 controller (NVMe 2.1, new-generation LDPC, nearly double the previous generation's performance) is in mass production at OEMs; its first UFS 3.1 embedded controller reached mass production in H1 2026 and supports QLC NAND; its enterprise PCIe 5.0 SSD controller is in mass-production testing and testing smoothly at leading customers, underpinning development of a next-generation enterprise PCIe 6.0 controller; UFS 2.2 and UFS 4.1 controllers are in development.

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply: Maxio increased strategic inventory stocking in the period; inventory was 21.27% of total assets at period end. It relies on a small number of foundries and OSATs as a fabless designer.
